Claim Atlas

Drag the slider or click the chart. The injury map and lists follow the day you pick.

Every flag states what the records show and where. Nothing here scores credibility, suggests a settlement value, sets a reserve or sends anything. Gaps, first-mention dates, deadlines and totals are computed by versioned rules. Venue rows are illustrative and not certified. The adjuster confirms, corrects or dismisses each fact.
